patient-reported-measures.reason: The current dataset does not establish whether these measures are systematically collected and reported by each county. No numeric PROM threshold is specified in the strategy figure.

nps.reason: The research contains the NPS target, but no measured cancer-unit NPS by county.

preventable-cancers.reason: No comparable county measurements of preventable cancer cases or assigned county reduction targets are loaded. Total cancer incidence cannot be substituted for preventable cases.

screening.reason: Every required screening programme must have an observation in the selected period and reach the participation target.

early-stage.reason: The stage sample is national and uses localised/non-localised categories. It does not provide county-level TNM stages I–II.

survival.reason: County lung cancer five-year relative survival is available for women and men. The full goal also needs pancreatic and liver survival plus a comparable Sweden–Norway benchmark tied to the strategy baseline.

mortality.reason: Annual cancer deaths for 2020–2025 are available for all 22 areas. The strategy gives a rounded national reference of 13,300 deaths (10% lower is 11,970), but does not specify county baselines. County counts are shown without inventing county reduction targets.

treatment.reason: The waiting-list snapshots do not measure the required cancer-specific diagnosis-to-treatment intervals. General waiting-list figures cannot establish this goal.

studies.reason: No comparable annual county-level counts of new clinical cancer and registry studies were found.

trials.reason: No county-level trial recruitment count and matching cancer-patient denominator were found.

medicine-assessment.reason: No measurement of implementation of the single assessment pathway is loaded. This is a system-level process goal, not a numeric county outcome.

equity.reason: Regional observations alone do not establish this goal. The current dataset does not demonstrate that the required socioeconomic comparisons are available or that these differences are used to guide each county’s services.

data.periodNote: Annual 2024 snapshot, assessed against the strategy benchmark. This is not a live feed or a single invitation round.
data.populationNote: Population is context only: year-end 2024 on 2026 boundaries. Screening geography timing is not fully verified. Never use population as the screening denominator.

goalDefinitions.name: Patient-reported measures
goalDefinitions.measure: Care experience, quality of life and wellbeing
goalDefinitions.target: Systematically measure and report care experience (NPS), quality of life and wellbeing (PROM)
goalDefinitions.reason: The current dataset does not establish whether these measures are systematically collected and reported by each county. No numeric PROM threshold is specified in the strategy figure.

goalDefinitions.name: Patient experience
goalDefinitions.target: NPS above 80 in units treating cancer patients
goalDefinitions.reason: The research contains the NPS target, but no measured cancer-unit NPS by county.

goalDefinitions.name: Preventable cancers
goalDefinitions.measure: Annual reduction in preventable cancer cases
goalDefinitions.target: 1,000 fewer preventable cancer cases per year nationally
goalDefinitions.strategyNote: The strategy estimates around 10,000 preventable cancers nationally. This is a reference estimate, not an observed county value or a county allocation.
goalDefinitions.reason: No comparable county measurements of preventable cancer cases or assigned county reduction targets are loaded. Total cancer incidence cannot be substituted for preventable cases.

goalDefinitions.name: Screening participation
goalDefinitions.target: At least 80% participation in every screening programme in every county
goalDefinitions.reason: Every required screening programme must have an observation in the selected period and reach the participation target.

goalDefinitions.name: Early diagnosis
goalDefinitions.target: At least 70% of cancers diagnosed at stages I–II
goalDefinitions.reason: The stage sample is national and uses localised/non-localised categories. It does not provide county-level TNM stages I–II.

goalDefinitions.name: Five-year survival
goalDefinitions.target: Five-year survival for poor-prognosis cancers reaches the Nordic level
goalDefinitions.strategyNote: The Nordic benchmark is the mean of Sweden and Norway. The strategy footnote specifies increases from the 2023 NORDCAN level of more than 14 percentage points for lung cancer, 6 for pancreatic cancer and 14 for liver cancer.
goalDefinitions.reason: County lung cancer five-year relative survival is available for women and men. The full goal also needs pancreatic and liver survival plus a comparable Sweden–Norway benchmark tied to the strategy baseline.

goalDefinitions.name: Cancer mortality
goalDefinitions.strategyNote: The strategy cites approximately 13,300 cancer deaths per year nationally. It does not assign county baselines.
goalDefinitions.reason: Annual cancer deaths for 2020–2025 are available for all 22 areas. The strategy gives a rounded national reference of 13,300 deaths (10% lower is 11,970), but does not specify county baselines. County counts are shown without inventing county reduction targets.

goalDefinitions.name: Timely treatment
goalDefinitions.target: Patients receive treatment within cancer-specific target times
goalDefinitions.strategyNote: The strategy refers to THL Guidance 21/2016 on monitoring access to cancer treatment.
goalDefinitions.reason: The waiting-list snapshots do not measure the required cancer-specific diagnosis-to-treatment intervals. General waiting-list figures cannot establish this goal.

goalDefinitions.name: New cancer studies
goalDefinitions.measure: Annual growth in clinical and registry studies
goalDefinitions.target: Increase new clinical cancer and registry studies by 10% per year
goalDefinitions.strategyNote: The strategy footnote sets a national ambition of approximately 200 new clinical cancer studies per year by 2035. This is an annual total, not 200 cumulative studies or a county quota.
goalDefinitions.reason: No comparable annual county-level counts of new clinical cancer and registry studies were found.

goalDefinitions.name: Trial participation
goalDefinitions.measure: Cancer patients recruited to interventional trials
goalDefinitions.target: More than 10% of cancer patients recruited to interventional trials
goalDefinitions.reason: No county-level trial recruitment count and matching cancer-patient denominator were found.

goalDefinitions.name: Cancer-medicine assessment
goalDefinitions.target: Assess cancer medicines through a single assessment pathway
goalDefinitions.reason: No measurement of implementation of the single assessment pathway is loaded. This is a system-level process goal, not a numeric county outcome.

goalDefinitions.name: Equity in cancer services
goalDefinitions.measure: Use of regional and socioeconomic differences in service planning
goalDefinitions.target: Make regional and socioeconomic differences in cancer incidence, care and mortality available and use them to guide services
goalDefinitions.reason: Regional observations alone do not establish this goal. The current dataset does not demonstrate that the required socioeconomic comparisons are available or that these differences are used to guide each county’s services.
